maskMethod: Whole-image RGB proxy: G > R + 20, B > R + 20, G > 0.88 * B. It can include scene colours and miss faint glow; it is not a visibility/readability pass criterion.
farViewComparisonLimit: 05 and 14 use different times, observer distances, paths, Bloom states and resolutions. Do not directly difference them or treat mask counts as a controlled Bloom comparison.
wallAssessment: Both actual captures show opaque stone with no visible energy leaking through. Solas frames are not pixel-identical; mean per-channel difference stays below 0.24 on an 8-bit scale. Colour masks and differences supplement visual inspection, not proof that temporal variation is zero.
performanceScope: Real whole-client reported FPS, 60 FPS cap, isolated world; not a GPU timer or universal benchmark.
